name.ja: Ｂトレインショーティー　485系・ボンネットタイプ

brands.ja: Bトレインショーティー

description.ja: • 国鉄の地方幹線電化拡大によって誕生した50/60ヘルツ兼用の交直流特急電車。
description.en: • A 50/60Hz AC/DC limited express train created by the expansion of electrification of local trunk lines by Japanese National Railways.

description.ja: • 初期のグループは先頭車がボンネットタイプで、中間車も含めてキノコ形のクーラーカバーが搭載されているのが特徴。
description.en: • In the early groups, the leading car had a bonnet type, and the middle cars were also equipped with mushroom-shaped cooler covers.

description.ja: • 全盛期の東北本線、常磐線を再現できる寒冷地仕様。
description.en: • A cold region version that can recreate the Tohoku Main Line and Joban Line in their heyday.

description.ja: • 付属のヘッドマークシールは往年の東北本線、常磐線が中心。
description.en: • The attached head mark seals are mainly for the Tohoku Main Line and Joban Line.

description.ja: • ２種類の屋根板付属で、中間車はモハ484形（パンタグラフあり）と485形（パンタグラフなし）に作り分け可能。
description.en: • Two types of roof plates are included, and the intermediate car can be made into Moha 484 type (with pantograph) and 485 type (without pantograph).
